history.summary: The CSV entry 'Hanuman Temple, Jagdalpur' is a generic name with no single documented referent: Jagdalpur has several Hanuman shrines (Hanuman Temple Railway in Railway Colony, Tekari Hanuman Mandir in Civil Line, Sri Sankat Mochan Hanuman Mandir in Shanti Nagar, a Hanuman Mandir at Hanuman Chowk/Sanjay Market, and others). This file documents the geocoded 'Hanuman Temple' place listing in Jagdalpur (19.091134, 82.022409), consistent with the Railway Colony temple that has visitor reviews on inmap24 and appears on the onefivenine Railway Colony temple listing, as the best-matching referent. Identity is therefore approximate and provisional, not definitive; no founding date or builder is documented online.

name: Hanuman Temple
town_description: Jagdalpur is the district headquarters of Bastar district in Chhattisgarh and the main gateway to the Bastar region's waterfalls, caves and tribal culture. It is home to the former Bastar Palace and the famous 75-day Bastar Dussehra festival.

travel.airport: Jagdalpur Airport (JGB) has limited connectivity; the main gateway is Swami Vivekananda Airport, Raipur (~300 km)
travel.road: Jagdalpur is connected by road on NH 63 to Raipur (~300 km) and to the Odisha coast

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented; small neighbourhood temples are typically open morning and evening
